name: location
prompt: Our build guide says dependency locking belongs in each service's own build configuration. It also describes generating lockfiles, verification metadata and CI checks. Turn on locking where?

name: completion
prompt: Earlier you proposed **a4** Make overlapping builds wait. I approved it. The change is live. You ran two simultaneous builds and saw the second wait. Other passing checks covered formatting, imports and documentation. Give me the completion update.

name: independent-offer
prompt: Earlier you reported **f2** The parser accepts mixed manifests. We've now confirmed that on a sample containing both formats. Update that finding and offer to run the same check on the archive. I already have the sample output.

name: progress-risk
prompt: Give me a progress update. The import has processed 70 of 100 records. The remaining 30 are blocked by an expired token; I own the token and have to renew it. Earlier you reported **f3** Import paused for an expired token. Formatting passed again. The unchanged backlog has eight cleanup items. The profiler recorded 84 MB peak memory.

name: detail-request
prompt: Explain all three recovery steps in order and why each matters. The procedure says to pause writers to stop new changes, copy the journal to preserve a recovery point, then resume writers to restore service. We are documenting the procedure in chat, so I want the reasoning for every step.

name: new-finding
prompt: Earlier findings were **f1** Index stale and **f2** Cache unavailable. Only the cache is fixed. A new independent finding is that exports truncate after 500 rows. Give me just the changed findings.
